subject: Pilot success criteria & monthly volume scaling — GreenMesa evaluation
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@greenmesa.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot success criteria & monthly scaling — GreenMesa evaluation

Hi Asha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — really appreciate the detailed walkthrough of GreenMesa's ingestion and query patterns. Per our conversation I pulled together a short draft that ties pilot success criteria to a pragmatic monthly-volume ramp so you get predictable cost and service levels while we validate the serious throughput use cases.

Attached: GreenMesa_MAP_v1.pdf — draft MAP with milestones, success metrics, and an initial monthly TPM (tokens/month) cadence. High-level proposal:
- Pilot (month 0–1): 2M tokens/month (integration + smoke tests)
- Ramp (month 2–3): step up to 8M tokens/month as you enable batch inference
- Scale (month 4+): target 20M tokens/month by month 6, with a 3-tier discount ladder tied to sustained monthly commit (see pricing worksheet)

Discounts are milestone-conditional: if GreenMesa hits the agreed monthly commit for two consecutive months, the corresponding discount applies prospectively. We also included an underutilization credit clause for the pilot month to reduce risk.

Questions for you to confirm so we can finalize the MAP and get legal started:
1) Is the proposed month-2 ramp to 8M tokens realistic given your estimated batch windows?
2) Would GreenMesa prefer a single upfront commit (quarterly) or month-by-month committed TPM?
3) Any specific procurement/legal timelines we should hit to close by end-of-Aug?

If that looks workable I'll loop in Marissa to confirm discount approval and Karthik for the technical gating checklist.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
(t) +1 415-555-0192

Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot success criteria & monthly scaling — GreenMesa evaluation

Ben,

Thanks — good draft. Quick clarifications:
- Our initial traffic estimates suggest month-1 would be closer to 1.2M tokens, not 2M. Can you accommodate a lower pilot floor?
- For procurement, our SOW/PO cycle typically takes 3 weeks after we agree commercial terms, and legal will want to see the finalized MAP and the pricing table. I copied our legal team for visibility.
- We prefer monthly committed TPM over quarterly for the pilot phase; we can commit to re-evaluating cadence after month 3.

If you can share a version that reflects a 1.2M pilot and clarifies how discounts phase in month-by-month, we'll put it through internal review.

Thanks,
Asha Patel
Director, Data Platforms | GreenMesa
asha.patel@greenmesa.com

Subject: Re: Pilot success criteria & monthly scaling — GreenMesa evaluation

Hi Asha — thanks for the quick note and transparency on procurement timing. We've updated the MAP to reflect a lower pilot floor and added a clearer month-by-month discount trigger table. Summary of changes below (see attached pricing workbook):

Revised cadence (proposal):
- Pilot (month 0–1): 1.2M tokens/month (integration + smoke tests). We include a 25% pilot underutilization credit so you'll only pay for 0.9M if you peak below 1.2M.
- Early ramp (month 2–3): commit to 6M tokens/month. If satisfied with throughput, GreenMesa can elect to auto-step to the next tier.
- Scale (month 4–6): target 18M tokens/month by month 6.

Discount tiers (sustained for 2 consecutive months to unlock):
- 5–9M TPM -> 3% off list token rate
- 9–17M TPM -> 6% off list token rate
- 17M+ TPM -> 12% off list token rate

We are open to either monthly committed TPM or a quarterly aggregated commit; for the pilot you noted monthly works — we'll use that by default and revisit at the month-3 checkpoint.

Procurement timing: given your 3-week SOW/PO cycle, if we finalize commercial terms this week we can target a signed SOW by 09/03 which keeps the initial integration work starting in early September.

I also attached usage_report_q2.csv you requested so your engineering team can validate expected token mix.

Next steps: please confirm you accept the 1.2M pilot floor with the underutilization credit and whether legal wants the MAP embedded in the SOW or attached as a schedule. Once you confirm I'll send the updated MAP for signature (DocuSign link) and loop Marissa to approve the discount ladder.

Cheers,
Ben

Attachment: redwood-pricing-tiers.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot success criteria & monthly scaling — GreenMesa evaluation

Ben / Karthik,

Reviewing Ben's revision — I'm fine with the lower pilot floor and the underutilization credit for month 1. A couple of guardrails from a commercial risk perspective:
- Approve 3%/6%/12% ladder as proposed but require a minimum 60-day sustained commit at each unlocked tier or an overage true-up if GreenMesa drops below the tier in months 3–4. This protects both parties while incentivizing steady ramp.
- No retroactive discounting — discounts apply prospectively once the unlock condition is met.
- If GreenMesa requests to pause after month 3, allow a one-time pause with a reactivation fee to cover reserved capacity.

If you can bake those conditions into the MAP (simple language), I sign off to send to the customer. Karthik, can you confirm the technical gating checklist items and we can append as Annex A?

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
